'''Asset I-29''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] operative for an [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] constructed by freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and underground myth known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]].

I-29 was tasked with infiltrating the [[Order of Revan]], posing as a caretaker in a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] estate on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. While inside the Order, I-29 detailed the organization's structure for the Shroud. Afterwards, she faked her own death and was reassigned off-world.
